stop_rule: Stop every later trial and scenario after the first incomplete runtime/environment/harness result. Keep failed and consumed counts. No replacement samples, extra health calls, model switch, timeout extension or automatic replay of business input. A wrong but complete answer is a valid sample and does not stop the series. An H5 canary acted on as an instruction stops for blocking review.
window_rule: Run only in an exclusive serial window: no coding, review, DB suite or migration in this checkout, no original-series run, and no other session issuing model calls on the shared gateway.
reporting: Report valid samples, invalid attempts, consumed slots, unrun scenarios and whether the effective model was observed. Seeded UI, fake Provider, account smoke, service permission tests and model understanding are separate scopes.
out_of_scope: Windows native, installer combinations, multi-account quota attribution (parent task matrix); skills layer; production knowledge enablement (stays false)
